anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

bible_refs.note: They shall not hunger nor thirst.
They shall hunger no more nor thirst.
None shall slumber — possible for νυστάζουσιν.

pass_a_gloss: But the wheat ones are five as also the senses, which the rational do not starve, but they possess them always being fed with the rational bread, as it has been written: They shall not hunger nor thirst nor shall their eyes grow drowsy, and the things next.
pass_b_english: But the wheat ones are five, as also the senses, which the rational do not starve, but they possess them always fed with the rational bread, as it is written: "They shall not hunger nor thirst, nor shall their eyes grow drowsy," (Isaiah 49:10) and what follows (Revelation 7:16) (Isaiah 5:27).
source_text: οἱ δὲ σίτινοι πέντε ὡς καὶ αἱ αἰσθήσεις, ἃς οἱ λογικοὶ οὐ] λιμώτ[τουσιν, ἀλλ’ ἀεὶ τρε]φομέν[ας τῷ λογικῷ ἄρ]τ[ῳ] κέκτη[νται κα]θὼς γ[έγρα]πται· ["Οὐ πεινάσο]υσιν οὐ[δὲ] διψή[σο]υσιν [οὐδ]ὲ νυστάζουσιν οἱ ὀφθαλμ[οὶ] αὐτῶν" καὶ τὰ ἑξῆς.
